goal: Restore per-tag-per-anchor update rate and anchor Poll reception to 98-99%

fleet.note: Boards were on a desk at 0.19-0.52 m. Antenna delay is UNCALIBRATED (uniform 16436), so absolute range is biased; SD and rate are the meaningful figures here.

verified_config.comment: $TABLEB independently computes frame_dur_us_required = 6701 for these values, so this point is spec-consistent and not an ad-hoc override.

result_counters.note: Per-tag Hz from these counters (82.7/76.8) exceeds the 74.6 Hz theoretical ceiling and is therefore STAT,CLEAR window skew across boards, not a real rate. Use result_per_pair, which times actual $RNG line arrival over one wall-clock window.

guard_sweep.comment: Run after restoring resp_base=700 / resp_pitch=1100 / report_base=1100 / report_pitch=1100. guard_us is NON-MONOTONIC: 300 is the optimum for both rate and reception.

root_causes.symptom: Anchor Poll reception collapsed to 74.4% / 58.7% and rate dropped
root_causes.cause: The $AUTOTIME-derived timing set (resp_base 750, resp_pitch 1244, report_base 1239, report_pitch 1240, T_f 7218) is looser but materially worse. $MEASURE's proc_* stats are survivor-biased -- recorded only after radio_tx_at() succeeds -- so $AUTOTIME inflates slot budgets when reception is already degraded, trading rate away for nothing.
root_causes.fix: Restore resp_base 700 / resp_pitch 1100 / report_base 1100 / report_pitch 1100, which $TABLEB confirms requires T_f=6701.

root_causes.cause: rx_timeout_us raised to 1200 while resp_pitch_us was 1244. Slot 0's RX window stayed open until 2150 us while Response[1] arrived at 2194 us -- only 44 us apart -- so slot 0 swallowed slot 1's frame.
root_causes.fix: Keep rx_timeout_us well below resp_pitch_us. 900 vs 1100 is safe.

root_causes.symptom: Range SD 110 cm with 40.7 m / 31.3 m outliers
root_causes.cause: REPORT_LOST forces SS-TWR fallback (RNG_FLAG_SS_FALLBACK), which is clock-offset sensitive and emits wild values. At ~4% fallback the outliers dominated SD.
root_causes.fix: Same timing fix. SS-TWR fallback fell to ~1%, and raw SD now equals outlier-robust SD in every pair (2.0-7.7 cm).

root_causes.symptom: Apparent rate drops and torn/bogus serial lines during measurement
root_causes.cause: Leftover tools/*.py readers (e.g. table.py) holding the same ports and splitting the stream. One stale reader made ESP_T1's $CFG hash read back as None.
root_causes.fix: pgrep for tools/*.py before measuring; validate every line with uwb.check_line().

root_causes.symptom: cfg_hash mismatch across the fleet (three boards 0x22D5, one 0x3F27)
root_causes.cause: A reconfiguration run aborted partway when the boards were unplugged, leaving DWM_A2 on the previous value. Mismatched hashes cause frames to be dropped outright.
root_causes.fix: Always re-read $CFG on all nodes and confirm one common hash after provisioning.

not_causes: Physical-layer rx_errors: DWM_A1 logs 14014 rx_errors/45s vs DWM_A2's 400, yet the two have essentially equal Poll reception (99.2% vs 98.1%). RF noise was not the limiter.
TDMA scheduling: tx_late is 0 on all four nodes, resp_tx == polls_rx exactly on both anchors, and per tag the two anchors agree to 0.1 Hz.
ESP32 proc_us margin: widening resp_base_us from 750 to 950 against proc_us=718 made reception slightly worse, not better.
outstanding: Antenna delay is uncalibrated (uniform 16436) on all four nodes; absolute range is biased. Needs one surveyed distance to calibrate.
DWM_A2 shows a consistent ~2.5 point deficit vs A1 (97.1-97.7% vs 99.6-99.9%), tracked to REPORT_LOST on its Report slot. Not yet explained.
uart_baud=921600 is deliberately NOT applied to the DWM1001s -- raising their console baud made line corruption worse (~60% of lines) rather than better. They run at 115200.
